summary: Marchex, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a sublease agreement with RentSpree, Inc. for its office space in Seattle, WA (12,300 sq ft, term May 1, 2026 through September 28, 2027). Fixed monthly rent totals approximately $337,000 over the term, with an initial rate of $19.25/sq ft increasing to $19.50/sq ft after 12 months. The filing also discloses a noncash impairment charge of about $203,000 on the right-of-use asset. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation dynamics are present. This is a routine operational real estate transaction, not a special situation.
